creditsCost.description: Credits charged per execution of this tool. Omitted when `toolDetail` is `compact`.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the tool does.

id.description: The tool's identifier, formatted as `provider/capability`. Omitted when `toolDetail` is `compact`.

matchedBy.description: Why this tool was surfaced. Omitted when `toolDetail` is `compact`.

matchedUrls.description: URLs whose domain matched this tool, when matched by domain. Omitted when `toolDetail` is `compact`.

name.description: Human-readable name of the tool. Omitted when `toolDetail` is `compact`.

options.description: The capability's accepted options. Present only when `toolDetail` is `full`.

perRecord.description: Whether `creditsCost` is charged per record returned rather than per call. Omitted when `toolDetail` is `compact`.

response.description: Description of the shape of a successful response's `data`. Present only when `toolDetail` is `full`.

about.description: Human-readable description of the response payload.

key.description: The key under which the primary payload is returned, when applicable.

actions.description: Results of the actions specified in the `actions` parameter. Only present if the `actions` parameter was provided in the request

javascriptReturns.description: JavaScript return values, in the same order as the executeJavascript actions provided.

pdfs.description: PDFs generated, in the same order as the pdf actions provided.

scrapes.description: Scrape contents, in the same order as the scrape actions provided.

screenshots.description: Screenshot URLs, in the same order as the screenshot actions provided.

answer.description: Natural-language answer to the question supplied via the `question` format. Only present if a `question` format object was included in `formats`.

attributes.description: Attribute values extracted by the `attributes` format. Only present if an `attributes` format object was included in `formats`.

audio.description: Signed URL to the extracted MP3 audio file if `audio` is in `formats`. The signed URL expires after 1 hour.

blocks.description: Per-page typed layout blocks for PDFs. Present only when the request set the `blocks` PDF parser option.

height.description: Page render height in px. Null for pages that never rendered.

bbox.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] normalized 0-1 relative to the page width/height. Multiply by the page width/height to get pixel coordinates. Null when the page has no known dimensions.

layout.description: Layout-model detection score (0-1). Null when the page bypassed layout analysis.

ocr.description: Text confidence when the source path provides one; null otherwise.

content.description: Markdown fragment this block contributed to the document markdown.

id.description: Stable within a response: p<page>.b<index in reading order>.

label.description: Raw layout-model label, passthrough for forward compatibility.

markdownSpan.description: [start, end) character offsets into the document markdown covering this block's fragment. Null when a post-processing transform rewrote the fragment.

source.description: Pipeline path that produced the block (for example native_text, layout_ocr, tsr, formula_model, full_page).

type.description: Block type: title, section_header, text, table, formula, figure, caption, page_number, page_header, page_footer. New types may appear over time.

width.description: Page render width in px — the anchor for denormalizing bbox coordinates. Null for pages that never rendered.

branding.description: Branding information extracted from the page if `branding` is in `formats`. Includes colors, fonts, typography, spacing, components, and more.

colorScheme.description: The detected color scheme of the page.

colors.description: Brand colors extracted from the page.

fonts.description: Array of font families used on the page.

personality.description: Brand personality traits (tone, energy, target audience).

fontSizes.description: Font sizes for different text levels.

lineHeights.description: Line height values for different text types.

changeTracking.description: Change tracking information if `changeTracking` is in `formats`. Only present when the `changeTracking` format is requested.

changeStatus.description: The result of the comparison between the two page versions. 'new' means this page did not exist before, 'same' means content has not changed, 'changed' means content has changed, 'removed' means the page was removed.

diff.description: Git-style diff of changes when using 'git-diff' mode. Only present when the mode is set to 'git-diff'.

json.description: JSON comparison results when using 'json' mode. Only present when the mode is set to 'json'. This will emit a list of all the keys and their values from the `previous` and `current` scrapes based on the type defined in the `schema`. Example [here](/features/change-tracking)

previousScrapeAt.description: The timestamp of the previous scrape that the current page is being compared against. Null if no previous scrape exists.

visibility.description: The visibility of the current page/URL. 'visible' means the URL was discovered through an organic route (links or sitemap), 'hidden' means the URL was discovered through memory from previous crawls.

highlights.description: Relevant source text selected by the `highlights` format. Only present if a `highlights` format object was included in `formats`.

html.description: Cleaned HTML of the page if `html` is in `formats`. Removes `<script>`, `<style>`, `<noscript>`, `<meta>`, and `<head>` tags; converts relative URLs to absolute; resolves responsive image `srcset` to the largest version. Respects `onlyMainContent`, `includeTags`, and `excludeTags` filters.

links.description: List of links on the page if `links` is in `formats`

menu.description: Menu information extracted from the page if `menu` is in `formats`. Includes the merchant, currency, and a list of sections, where each section carries items with description, images, price, availability, dietary tags, calories, and option groups.

confidence.description: A confidence score between 0 and 1 for the menu extraction.

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for the menu (e.g. 'USD'), reported only when the page sources it.

isMenu.description: Whether the page was identified as a menu.

merchant.description: The merchant the menu belongs to.

sourceUrl.description: The URL the item was extracted from.

url.description: The canonical URL of the item.

sourceUrl.description: The URL the menu was extracted from.

<any other metadata>.description: Other metadata extracted from HTML, can be a string or array of strings

concurrencyLimited.description: Whether this scrape was throttled due to team concurrency limits

concurrencyQueueDurationMs.description: Time in milliseconds the request waited in the concurrency queue. Only present when concurrencyLimited is true.

contentType.description: The content type (MIME type) of the page, e.g. text/html, application/pdf

description.description: Description extracted from the page, can be a string or array of strings

error.description: The error message of the page

keywords.description: Keywords extracted from the page, can be a string or array of strings

language.description: Language extracted from the page, can be a string or array of strings

numPages.description: For PDF inputs, the number of pages parsed (capped by the parsers maxPages option).

provider.description: Set when a third-party data provider served the URL.

creditsCost.description: What that access cost, in credits.

id.description: The provider that returned the data.

sourceURL.description: The original URL that was requested. May differ from the page's final URL if redirects occurred.

statusCode.description: The status code of the page

title.description: Title extracted from the page, can be a string or array of strings

totalPages.description: For PDF inputs, the document's true page count before any maxPages capping. Omitted when it cannot be determined; a totalPages greater than numPages indicates the result was truncated.

url.description: The final URL of the page after all redirects have been followed.

pages.description: Physical per-page markdown for PDFs. Present only when the request set the `pages` PDF parser option.

product.description: Product information extracted from the page if `product` is in `formats`. Includes title, brand, category, description, and variants. Pricing, availability, and images live on each variant.

category.description: The product category, optionally as a breadcrumb path (e.g. 'Electronics > Audio > Headphones').

url.description: The canonical URL of the product page.

variants.description: Product variants (e.g. different colors or sizes).

availability.description: The availability of the variant. Always present on a variant.

inStock.description: Whether the variant is in stock.

price.description: The current price of the variant.

sale.description: Sale/discount information for the variant, present when the variant is discounted.

originalPrice.description: The original (pre-discount) price of the variant.

rawBase64.description: The Base64-encoded original HTTP response body if `rawBase64` is in `formats`. A bare Base64 string, not a data URI. The MIME type is in `metadata.contentType`.

rawHtml.description: The exact, unmodified HTML as received from the page if `rawHtml` is in `formats`. No cleaning or filtering is applied.

screenshot.description: Screenshot of the page if `screenshot` is in `formats`. Screenshots expire after 24 hours and can no longer be downloaded.

summary.description: Summary of the page if `summary` is in `formats`

tools.description: Tool contracts matched to the scraped page's domain. Present only when `domainTools` is `true` on the request. Requires Alexandria access and no zero data retention (403 otherwise); free.

video.description: Signed URL to the extracted video file if `video` is in `formats`. The signed URL expires after 1 hour.

warning.description: Can be displayed when using LLM Extraction. Warning message will let you know any issues with the extraction.

tools.description: Tool contracts discovered from the Alexandria catalogue. Present when `alexandria` is among the sources or when `domainTools` was requested; up to `limit` results per discovery source (semantic matches from the `alexandria` source, domain matches from `domainTools`).

audio.description: Signed URL to the extracted MP3 audio file if `audio` is in `formats`. The signed URL expires after 1 hour.

links.description: Links found if requested in formats

markdown.description: Markdown content if scraping was requested

numPages.description: For PDF inputs, the number of pages parsed (capped by the parsers maxPages option).

sourceURL.description: The original URL that was requested. May differ from the page's final URL if redirects occurred.

totalPages.description: For PDF inputs, the document's true page count before any maxPages capping. Omitted when it cannot be determined; a totalPages greater than numPages indicates the result was truncated.

url.description: The final URL of the page after all redirects have been followed.
